<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <string>
#include <cctype>

using namespace std;

static long long C[61][61];
static int Acount[61], Bcount[61];
static long long smallestDiff;
static string input;
static map<long long, long long> dp;

int readInteger() {
    int result = 0;
    bool isNegative = false;
    int c;
    bool hasStarted = false;
    while ((c = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (c == '-') {
            hasStarted = true;
            isNegative = true;
            continue;
        } else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            hasStarted = true;
            result = result * 10 + (c - '0');
        } else if (hasStarted) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return isNegative ? -result : result;
}

long long readLongNumber() {
    long long value = 0;
    bool isNegative = false;
    int c;
    bool hasStarted = false;
    while ((c = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (c == '-') {
            hasStarted = true;
            isNegative = true;
            continue;
        } else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            hasStarted = true;
            value = value * 10 + (c - '0');
        } else if (hasStarted) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return isNegative ? -value : value;
}

string readToken() {
    string buffer;
    int c;
    bool started = false;
    while ((c = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (isalnum(c) || c == '?') {
            started = true;
            buffer += (char)c;
        } else if (started) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return buffer;
}

void explore(long long leftVal, long long rightVal, int pos1, int pos2, int N) {
    long long diff = abs(leftVal - rightVal);
    if (smallestDiff <= 1 || diff - C[pos1][N] * C[pos2][N] >= smallestDiff) return;
    if (pos1 == N - 1 && pos2 == N - 1) {
        if (diff < smallestDiff) smallestDiff = diff;
        return;
    }
    if (pos1 >= N) {
        long long diff1 = C[pos1][N] - C[pos1 - 1][N];
        long long factor = C[pos2][N];
        explore(leftVal, rightVal + diff1 * factor, pos1 - 1, pos2, N);
    }
    if (pos2 >= N) {
        long long diff2 = C[pos2][N] - C[pos2 - 1][N];
        long long factor = C[pos1][N];
        explore(leftVal + diff2 * factor, rightVal, pos1, pos2 - 1, N);
    }
}

long long calculate(long long leftVal, long long rightVal, int pos1, int pos2, int N) {
    long long diff = abs(leftVal - rightVal);
    if (diff - C[pos1][N] * C[pos2][N] > smallestDiff) return 0L;
    long long signature = (leftVal << 7) | (pos1 << 4) | pos2;
    if (dp.count(signature)) return dp[signature];
    if (pos1 < N || pos2 < N) {
        if (pos1 >= Acount[pos1 + pos2] && pos2 >= Bcount[pos1 + pos2]) {
            int total = pos1 + pos2;
            pos1 -= Acount[total];
            pos2 -= Bcount[total];
            return C[pos1 + pos2][pos1];
        }
        return 0L;
    }
    long long total = 0L;
    char ch = input[pos1 + pos2 - 1];
    if (ch != 'B') {
        long long diff1 = C[pos1][N] - C[pos1 - 1][N];
        long long factor = C[pos2][N];
        total += calculate(leftVal, rightVal + diff1 * factor, pos1 - 1, pos2, N);
    }
    if (ch != 'A') {
        long long diff2 = C[pos2][N] - C[pos2 - 1][N];
        long long factor = C[pos1][N];
        total += calculate(leftVal + diff2 * factor, rightVal, pos1, pos2 - 1, N);
    }
    dp[signature] = total;
    return total;
}

int main() {
    int N = readInteger();
    int M = readInteger();
    
    for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (N + M); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            if (j == 0 || j == i) C[i][j] = 1;
            else C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j];
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i <= 60; i++) {
        Acount[i] = 0;
        Bcount[i] = 0;
    }
    
    long long left = 0, right = 0;
    int i1 = N + M, i2 = N + M;
    while (i1 >= N && i2 >= N) {
        if (left > right) {
            long long diff1 = C[i1][N] - C[i1 - 1][N];
            long long factor = C[i2][N];
            right += diff1 * factor;
            i1--;
        } else {
            long long diff2 = C[i2][N] - C[i2 - 1][N];
            long long factor = C[i1][N];
            left += diff2 * factor;
            i2--;
        }
    }
    smallestDiff = abs(left - right);
    
    dp.clear();
    explore(0, 0, N + M, N + M, N);
    
    input = readToken();
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (N + M); i++) {
        Acount[i + 1] = Acount[i] + (input[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
        Bcount[i + 1] = Bcount[i] + (input[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    
    long long result = calculate(0, 0, N + M, N + M, N);
    cout << result << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
